purpose: Decompose one admitted Event into sparse governed spectral projections without creating duplicate truth or semantic noise.
invariants: The originating Event remains whole and unchanged.
Spectral projections retain originating Event identity and provenance.
V I B G Y O R are routing/filter bands; their business semantics are contract-defined rather than universally hard-coded.
A receiver may derive business meaning only from explicitly admitted matching spectral bands and vectors.
A non-matching projection is semantically inert even if transport delivers it to the receiver.
Presence at a receiver never creates a Chord, relationship or consequence by itself.
Spectral match is necessary where required but does not replace evidence, authority, timing, Enterprise, confidence or passage gates.
Spectral band and vector strength are independent dimensions.
AI may propose spectral classification but may not admit a consequential spectral route or Chord alone.
Sweepers may flag or retire misrouted active projections but may never delete the originating admitted Event or Evidence.
prism_due_diligence: what dimensions and values are being decomposed
who originated and who may receive
when the route is valid or stale
